description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would roll on the Toll Table.

You do not roll. Choose any result on the Toll Table and apply it as though you had rolled it; it is a real Toll and everything that responds to a Toll responds to this one. No Miasma is refilled by doing this. If you have already used Toll Control to reroll this Toll, you may still use this feat on it, and the chosen result replaces the reroll.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Choir's Toll random table (TOLL) is referenced by roughly ten cards in this class. No rule element models rolling on a GM table, or substituting a chosen result for a roll -- zero precedent searched or expected, this is squarely outside anything system.rules can represent.
